name: AlertDialog
description: A dialog that interrupts to ask something: `role="alertdialog"`, always modal, and **never dismissed by a press outside**, because a decision that can be clicked away is one the user did not make.

keyboard.action: Closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
Cycles focus inside it and never leaves.

a11y: `role="alertdialog"`, which tells a screen reader the content is an alert rather than a panel, so the name and description are announced together on open.
A press outside is ignored on purpose; Escape is not, so the dialog is never a trap.
